evidence: Under conditions of ALD, the surface sites become saturated with precursor and excess precursor not mono-atomically attached to the surface is removed by subsequent purging. As shown in Figure 8, the growth rate per ALD cycle levels off to ~0.6 Å/cycle (which is sub monolayer growth per cycle) at about 5 doses of precursor per cycle with no variation of film thickness within the ALD regime. The self-limiting nature of the ALD process is also indicated by the high degree of uniformity in the film thickness across the substrate surface.
